name: Saty Stock Notifier for WooCommerce
author: farjanaplugin

sections.description:
Saty Stock Notifier for WooCommerce is a lightweight WooCommerce plugin that allows customers to subscribe for email notifications when an out-of-stock product becomes available again.

When a product goes out of stock, a subscription form appears on the product page. Once the product is back in stock, all subscribers automatically receive an email notification.

Key Features

  • Simple email subscription form on out-of-stock product pages
  • Automatic email notification when product is back in stock
  • Admin dashboard to manage all subscribers
  • Secure token-based unsubscribe link in every email
  • Lightweight and easy to use
  • No configuration required — works out of the box

How It Works

  1. Customer visits an out-of-stock product page
  2. Customer enters their email and clicks “Notify Me”
  3. When the product is back in stock, customer receives an email automatically
  4. Customer can unsubscribe anytime using the link in the email
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. WooCommerce must be installed and activated
  4. That’s it! The subscription form will automatically appear on out-of-stock product pages
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, WooCommerce must be installed and activated.

Will customers receive spam emails?

No. Customers only receive one email when the product is back in stock. Every email includes an unsubscribe link.

Does it support Variable Products?

Currently, Saty Stock Notifier supports Simple Products only. Variable product support is coming soon!

Where can I see all subscribers?

Go to Stock Alerts in your WordPress admin menu.

Do I need an SMTP plugin?

On most hosting providers, default emails might get blocked. For 100% reliable email delivery, we highly recommend installing an SMTP plugin.
